answer_2.quote: For text generation tasks, we evaluate extracted models with a semantic-level and two lexical-level metrics, BERTScore, BLEU, and Rouge-L, all of which are commonly used in the NLG evaluation. Regarding reasoning tasks (e.g., QA), we use Precision, Recall, Accuracy, and F1 score as their evaluation metrics.
